# More Confidence Intervals

## Confidence Intervals for Proportions

If we know the **sample proportion** and want to compute a **confidence interval** for the true proportion we use the following formula for the interval,

$$(\hat{p} - z_{\text{CL}}\sqrt{\frac{\hat{p}(1-\hat{p})}{n-1}}, \bar{x} + z_{\text{CL}}\sqrt{\frac{\hat{p}(1-\hat{p})}{n-1}})$$

We call 

$$\sqrt{\frac{\hat{p}(1-\hat{p})}{n-1}}$$
